title: Generated AC1018 TABLE direct-codec allocation rollback and retry

implementation.codec: DRW_Table::encodeDwg stages body and handle streams in private copies, catches emission exceptions, and swaps only on success

failureAssertions: Each injected bad_alloc is caught and reported as codec refusal.
Pre-seeded body bytes, handle bytes, and bit counts are unchanged after each refusal.
The same DRW_Table instance and output buffers successfully retry after every failure.
Successful retries preserve the pre-existing body and handle prefixes.

interpretation: This closes the direct generated AC1018 TABLE codec's observed allocation-exception rollback path only. It does not exercise public dwgRW::writeTable, class-instance publication, the *T geometry/reference graph, physical source-to-output parity, an independent reader, or native TABLE behavior. Keep public TABLE output refused.
